DEV1.description: A Synapse integration pipeline run failed in the last 30 minutes (DEV1 environment)
DEV1.query: SynapseIntegrationPipelineRuns | where Status =~ "Failed" | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by RunId | extend WorkspaceName = tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/")[8]) | project FailureTimestamp = coalesce(End, TimeGenerated), PipelineName, RunId, WorkspaceName, _ResourceId
